core.prompt: Redesign the Heart of the Mountain relic for the dark fantasy dungeon crawler Deepdelve, as ONE spectacular but grounded painted game item. Reference1 is its OLD red heart-shaped gemstone: replace that corny symmetrical jewelry design completely. Reference2 is the game's approved Heartforged monster painting: match its weathered black forged metal, ancient dwarven angular engravings, rich visible painterly brush texture, searing forge-gold interior and deep charcoal shadows. The artifact is the primordial first fire of the old mountain smiths, immensely powerful and ancient, something dangerous that could keep a whole mountain alive. Design a heavy fist-sized irregular elongated core of cracked volcanic black stone, with a dense almost-white golden molten center visible through a few deep orange-gold fissures, restrained rusty dark iron ribs forged around it and a small number of worn geometric rune cuts. Its silhouette subtly suggests a rugged organic heart or a broken mountain seed, NEVER a Valentine heart, NEVER a polished faceted ruby, NEVER a smooth glowing ball. Keep most of the shell matte, dark and substantial so the contained fire feels intensely luminous. The metallic cage should be sparse, physically connected, asymmetrical and purposeful, not ornamental jewelry or sci-fi machinery. Slight three-quarter view, upright, complete artifact comfortably inside the frame with 12 percent transparent margin. Large distinctive silhouette readable at 80px, no tiny busy particles. Quiet contained menace, epic ancient relic worthy of a final dungeon victory. SINGLE isolated object on a truly transparent background, softly painted edges but strong coherent form, no environment, no floor, no pedestal, no floating shards or flames detached from the object, no excessive bloom, no text, no labels, no borders, no hands. Mature hand-painted monster-art aesthetic, NOT cartoon, NOT glossy 3D render. Square image, highest detail.

Full complete object only on a truly transparent background, no floor plane or detached shadow, no border, no text. Square image, highest detail.
